headline: Solara Active Pharma Sciences Limited: Rights Issue Reminder-cum-Forfeiture Notice issued to partly paid shareholders
sum: Solara Active Pharma Sciences has issued a Reminder-cum-Forfeiture Notice to partly paid shareholders via its Rights Issue Committee, a routine enforcement mechanism under SEBI(ICDR) Rules to collect overdue calls on rights shares.
detail: Solara Active Pharma Sciences Limited, a Hyderabad-based active pharmaceutical ingredients manufacturer and listed company (NSE), issued a Reminder-cum-Forfeiture Notice approved by its Rights Issue Committee to shareholders holding partly paid rights shares. The notice is a statutory reminder before forfeiture proceedings under the SEBI(ICDR) Rules and the company's Articles of Association, requiring shareholders to pay outstanding calls within a specified period or face cancellation and forfeiture of their allotment. This is a standard governance and investor-protection measure in rights issues to ensure capital is raised as committed.
